mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate sales (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent easing actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) increase and unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement of RSAFS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in one month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 300,000 does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows down to less than 1% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises, it signals a weakening demand and labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint movement of GDPC1 and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown.
